WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.stores, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region

SELECT 'sales' AS src, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines, min(sale_date) AS d0, max(sale_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26') OR (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), 0, NULL, NULL
FROM fact_return_line WHERE (return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26') OR (return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.v) AS mine
  FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, f.store_key, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  ) n
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = n.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.dt
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
  SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT c.fiscal_year, count(*) AS stores, round(sum(m.mine),2) AS mine, round(sum(c.ctl),2) AS control, round(sum(m.mine)-sum(c.ctl),2) AS gap,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(coalesce(m.mine,0)-c.ctl) > 1) AS stores_off
FROM ctl c LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.store_id=c.store_id AND m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ns, count(*) AS days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = r.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT store_id, store_name, region,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AS weeks_ty, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25') AS weeks_ly,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE ns <= 0) AS zero_weeks,
  round(sum(ns) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26')/NULLIF(sum(ns) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25'),0),3) AS ratio
FROM wk GROUP BY ALL
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26') <> 13 OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25') <> 13 OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE ns <= 0) > 0 OR ratio NOT BETWEEN 0.8 AND 1.25
ORDER BY 1
